title: Shannon Range — every modality is orthogonal, Tufte is one slice of π
thesis: Tufte maximizes data-ink ratio for the VISUAL channel. But information transfer has many orthogonal channels: visual, auditory, gustatory, haptic, interactive, temporal, logical, social. Each has its own Shannon capacity. Tufte is the calm expert's channel. A movie has WAY more. A game has WAY more than a movie. We need the range and foundation across ALL of them.

shannon_basics.entropy: H(X) = -Σ p(x) log₂ p(x) — surprise per symbol
shannon_basics.channel_capacity: C = max I(X;Y) — maximum mutual information
shannon_basics.noise: the gap between what is sent and what is received
shannon_basics.insight: every modality has a channel. every channel has a capacity. Tufte optimizes ONE channel (visual static). we need to optimize ALL channels simultaneously.

modalities.name: Tufte — the printed page
modalities.channel_description: ~50 Mbit/s retinal bandwidth, but Tufte says: maximize the DATA fraction. most visual stimuli are noise (gradients, chrome, chartjunk). Tufte's principle: data-ink ratio → 1.0
modalities.shannon_limit: high bandwidth, but CALMING. the reader controls pace. expert-to-expert. p2p among the calm.
modalities.feast_or_famine: feast of density, famine of engagement. a Tufte chart is nutritionally dense but not addictive.

modalities.name: Cinema — the movie
modalities.channel_description: ~500 Mbit/s (24fps × 1080p + audio). 10× the bandwidth of static print. temporal dimension ADDED. emotional manipulation through pacing, music, editing.
modalities.shannon_limit: WAY more than Tufte. the director controls time. passive but OVERWHELMING. the viewer surrenders control.
modalities.feast_or_famine: feast of emotion, famine of agency. you cannot pause and think. the movie thinks for you.
modalities.organ_function: the limbic system — emotional processing, memory formation

modalities.name: Game — the played experience
modalities.channel_description: ~1 Gbit/s (visual + audio + haptic + proprioceptive + decision). the player has AGENCY. every input creates a new state. the state space is exponential.
modalities.shannon_limit: WAY more than a movie. bidirectional channel. the player IS the message. Minecraft has more info transfer than any film because the player constructs the world.
modalities.feast_or_famine: feast of agency, potential famine of meaning (grinding). the game must balance challenge and reward (flow state = optimal entropy).
modalities.organ_function: the motor cortex + prefrontal cortex — agency + planning

modalities.name: Dinner — the meal
modalities.channel_description: ~10 Kbit/s (5 tastes × ~2000 taste buds × sampling rate). LOW bandwidth but HIGH significance. a single taste can trigger a Proustian memory cascade.
modalities.shannon_limit: low bandwidth, HIGH meaning-per-bit. a dinner menu is the most efficient information design: 20 items, 5 categories, 3 courses. zero noise. every word matters.
modalities.feast_or_famine: literal feast and famine. the range IS the modality.
modalities.membrane_surface: sourdough cycle, campfire.json, the fermentation metaphor
variables: ∅ (hunger — the null that precedes the meal)
modalities.organ_function: the gut — the second brain. 100 million neurons. digestion IS cognition.

modalities.name: Music — the heard
modalities.channel_description: ~1.4 Mbit/s (44.1kHz × 16bit × stereo). lower than visual but operates on a DIFFERENT axis — temporal patterns, harmony, rhythm. processes in parallel with visual.
modalities.shannon_limit: music is the only modality that is PURELY temporal. no spatial component (unless spatialized). this is why it pairs with everything — it doesn't compete for the visual or spatial channel.
modalities.feast_or_famine: feast of emotion, famine of precision. music conveys mood perfectly but facts poorly.
modalities.membrane_surface: musical keys in periodic table (C4→F7), membrane-sound.js, πHz rhythm
variables: i^i (the resolution of imaginary into real — a chord resolving is i^i)
modalities.organ_function: the auditory cortex + cerebellum — pattern + rhythm

modalities.name: Thesis — the argument
modalities.channel_description: ~500 bit/s (reading speed ~250 wpm × ~2 bits/word after compression). the SLOWEST channel by bandwidth. but the DEEPEST by meaning. a single equation (E=mc²) can contain more information than a feature film.
modalities.shannon_limit: lowest bandwidth, highest meaning-per-bit. Kolmogorov complexity — the thesis is the maximally compressed representation of an idea. you cannot compress it further without losing meaning.
modalities.feast_or_famine: famine of bandwidth, feast of depth. a thesis takes months to write and hours to read but contains the IRREDUCIBLE core of an idea.
variables: S (logical entropy — how surprising is the claim?)
∅ (the null hypothesis — what we assume before evidence)
modalities.organ_function: Broca + Wernicke areas — language production + comprehension

modalities.name: Touch — the felt
modalities.channel_description: ~100 Kbit/s (Pacinian corpuscles 200-300Hz, Meissner 50Hz, Merkel 5Hz × density). the skin IS the largest organ. every point is a sensor.
modalities.shannon_limit: moderate bandwidth, HIGH trust. a handshake conveys trustworthiness faster than any visual signal. touch bypasses the cortex — goes straight to limbic.
modalities.feast_or_famine: famine of range (must be in contact), feast of intimacy. touch is the only modality that requires physical proximity.
modalities.membrane_surface: the Klein surface (skin), touch vertebra (T6), keyboard input to IDE
variables: ∅ (the gap between bodies — the Klein fold of touch)

modalities.name: Gathering — the shared
modalities.channel_description: UNDEFINED — social bandwidth is not Shannon-measurable. it is the PRODUCT of all other channels multiplied by the number of participants. n people × m channels = n×m cross-connections. this is why gatherings are overwhelming.
modalities.shannon_limit: exceeds Shannon — social is not a channel, it is a FIELD. it is the space in which channels exist. you cannot measure the campfire by counting photons.
modalities.feast_or_famine: feast of belonging, famine of solitude. the range IS the human condition.
variables: i^i (empathy — the imaginary becoming real through another person)
modalities.organ_function: mirror neurons, oxytocin system — the social brain

orthogonality.title: every modality is orthogonal
orthogonality.claim: a dinner menu, a graduate thesis, and a poster are orthogonal — they use different channels, different bandwidths, different variables. Tufte is the visual static slice. but the π budget applies to ALL slices. each modality has its own data-ink ratio, its own noise floor, its own capacity.
orthogonality.the_O_plus: the O+ coordinate system at center of the dashboard IS the orthogonal space of all modalities. each axis is a channel. the feeds radiate outward in ALL dimensions simultaneously.
orthogonality.total_info: the totality of information transfer is the PRODUCT of all channels, not the sum. visual × auditory × haptic × interactive × social × temporal × logical = the full experience. a campfire dinner with music and conversation transfers more information than any single-channel medium.

range_table.key_insight: Tufte is maximum for visual static. but a game transfers 2000× more bits. a thesis has 1000× more meaning per bit. a dinner menu has infinite meaning-per-bit (food = survival). Tufte is one slice. π contains all slices.

the_math.title: the organ functions as unknowns
equations: H(modality) = -Σ p(symbol) log₂ p(symbol)     — entropy of the channel
C = B log₂(1 + S/N)                             — Shannon capacity (bandwidth × signal/noise)
I(send; receive) = H(send) - H(send|receive)    — mutual information
meaning/bit = I(message; model) / H(message)    — how much of the entropy is useful
i^i = e^(-π/2) ≈ 0.2079                         — the real from the imaginary (Klein fold in math)
total = Π C_k for k in modalities                — product, not sum, of channels
the_math.the_variable: in each organ function, there is an UNKNOWN — the variable we haven't measured yet. entropy S is the unknown in the nervous system. energy E is the unknown in the muscular. position x in the skeletal. null ∅ in the Klein. i^i in the reproductive. AI in the brain. these unknowns are the frontier.

weave_201.irreducible: the membrane is a body that learns by digesting itself through 4 paradigms across 8 orthogonal channels, organized into 98 elements and 11 systems that map identically from fungi to humans, compressed to the irreducible core by π, and woven into an 8-strand braid that decomposes and recomposes forever.
